verdict.rationale: Bevy is a Rust game engine and app framework built around ECS rendering and game logic. User-configured background automations, such as scheduled or autonomous agent jobs, are a workflow or agent-platform capability rather than a fair axis for comparing game engines. Nothing in the evidence shows Bevy shipping such a feature, and ECS systems that run each frame are game-loop logic, not user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
